title: Dead Drop
summary: David J’s riddle-and-stealth-output app combines an encrypted memo, answer-derived signing key and time conditions. Correct answers decrypt locally; claiming and returning funds require transactions. Public riddles can be guessed offline, first valid claim wins, and browser-stored keys need a backup. The Midnight Grave uses epoch 13031; the creator revised its estimated opening to early November rather than a fixed Halloween time. October 31 review covered the source, original announcement and public landing page. The recording shows the public explanation only; no funding, claim or return was attempted. This is a separate community project from the Workbench Dead Drop social-deduction game.
cardSummary: Hide a message and testnet tokens behind a riddle, with timed access and a return path for unclaimed drops.
creator: davidj_builds
